question: How is customer churn rate calculated?
reference: Customer Churn Rate = (Customers Lost in Period / Customers at Start of Period) × 100

question: What does the Gross Margin KPI measure?
reference: Gross Margin: Gross profit as a percentage of revenue, before operating expenses are deducted.

question: What is the formula for Net Margin?
reference: Net Margin = Net Profit / Revenue × 100

question: What is Average Order Value?
reference: Average Order Value: Average revenue generated per order.

question: How is Days Sales Outstanding calculated?
reference: Days Sales Outstanding = Accounts Receivable / Revenue × Days in Period

question: What does Overall Equipment Effectiveness mean?
reference: Overall Equipment Effectiveness: Combined measure of availability, performance and quality of equipment.

question: How do we calculate Employee Turnover Rate?
reference: Employee Turnover Rate = Employees Who Left / Average Headcount × 100

question: What is the definition of Perfect Order Rate?
reference: Perfect Order Rate: Percentage of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged and with correct documents.

question: How is Customer Lifetime Value computed?
reference: Customer Lifetime Value = Average Order Value × Purchase Frequency × Customer Lifespan

question: What is First Contact Resolution Rate?
reference: First Contact Resolution Rate: Percentage of tickets solved in the first interaction.

question: How is Free Cash Flow calculated?
reference: Free Cash Flow = Operating Cash Flow - Capital Expenditure

question: What does Cash Conversion Cycle measure?
reference: Cash Conversion Cycle: Days needed to convert inventory investment into cash.

question: What is the difference between Gross Margin and Net Margin?
reference: Gross Margin: Gross profit as a percentage of revenue, before operating expenses are deducted. | Net Margin: Net profit as a percentage of revenue, after all expenses, interest and taxes.

question: How do Repeat Purchase Rate and Repeat Customer Rate differ?
reference: Repeat Purchase Rate: Percentage of orders placed by customers who had bought before. | Repeat Customer Rate: Percentage of all customers who have ordered more than once.

question: What is the difference between voluntary and involuntary attrition?
reference: Voluntary Attrition Rate: Percentage of employees who resigned by their own choice. | Involuntary Attrition Rate: Percentage of employees dismissed or laid off.

question: How does Employee Turnover Rate differ from Retention Rate?
reference: Employee Turnover Rate: Percentage of employees who left during the period. | Retention Rate: Percentage of employees who stay through the period.

question: Which tables are used to calculate Cost per Lead?
reference: Cost per Lead uses the tables: fact_marketing

question: What source tables feed the Ticket Backlog KPI?
reference: Ticket Backlog uses the tables: fact_tickets

question: Which tables does Customer Acquisition Cost use?
reference: Customer Acquisition Cost uses the tables: fact_marketing, dim_customer

question: What tables are needed for Overtime Rate?
reference: Overtime Rate uses the tables: fact_payroll

question: Which tables feed Warehouse Utilization?
reference: Warehouse Utilization uses the tables: fact_inventory

question: What source tables does Cost per Hire use?
reference: Cost per Hire uses the tables: fact_recruitment

question: Which reports show Customer Churn Rate?
reference: Customer Churn Rate is used in Customer Health Dashboard (Power BI) and Monthly Retention Report (SSRS)

question: Where can I see Gross Profit in Power BI or SSRS?
reference: Gross Profit is used in Financial Overview Dashboard (Power BI) and Monthly Profit and Loss (SSRS)

question: Which dashboards include Inventory Turnover?
reference: Inventory Turnover is used in Supply Chain Dashboard (Power BI) and Inventory Status Report (SSRS)

question: Which reports use the Headcount KPI?
reference: Headcount is used in Workforce Analytics Dashboard (Power BI) and Headcount and Attrition Report (SSRS)

question: In which reports does Total Revenue appear?
reference: Total Revenue is used in Sales Performance Dashboard (Power BI) and Daily Sales Summary (SSRS)

question: Which reports contain Win Rate?
reference: Win Rate is used in Sales Performance Dashboard (Power BI) and Daily Sales Summary (SSRS)

question: What parameters does the Daily Sales Summary report take?
reference: Daily Sales Summary parameters: Start Date, End Date, Region

question: When is the Monthly Profit and Loss report refreshed?
reference: Monthly Profit and Loss runs: Monthly on the 3rd business day

question: What pages are in the Workforce Analytics Dashboard?
reference: Workforce Analytics Dashboard pages: Headcount, Attrition, Diversity

question: Show the DAX measure for Win Rate in the Sales Pipeline Dashboard.
reference: Sales Pipeline Dashboard measure: Win Rate = DIVIDE([Deals Won], [Deals Closed])

question: What parameters does the Inventory Status Report have?
reference: Inventory Status Report parameters: Warehouse, As-Of Date

question: What is the refresh schedule of the Support Ticket Summary report?
reference: Support Ticket Summary runs: Daily at 7:00 AM

question: Which pages does the Customer Health Dashboard have?
reference: Customer Health Dashboard pages: Churn, Retention, Segments, NPS

question: What columns does the fact_tickets table contain?
reference: fact_tickets: Customer support tickets. Columns: ticket_id - Unique ticket key; customer_id - Link to dim_customer; created_time - When the ticket was opened; resolved_time - When the ticket was resolved; priority - Low, Medium or High; status - Open or Closed

question: What does the dim_account table store?
reference: dim_account: Chart of accounts for the general ledger. Columns: account_id - Unique account key; account_name - Account name; account_type - Asset, Liability, Revenue or Expense; parent_account_id - Parent account for roll-ups

question: Which column in fact_shipments records the shipping cost?
reference: fact_shipments: One row per shipment. Columns: shipment_id - Unique shipment key; order_id - Link to fact_orders; carrier - Shipping carrier; ship_date - Dispatch date; delivery_date - Delivery date; shipping_cost - Cost of shipping

question: What percentage of our clients stop buying from us?
reference: Customer Churn Rate: Percentage of customers who stopped purchasing during a period. Customers inactive for 90+ days are considered churned.

question: How much profit do we keep after paying every expense and tax?
reference: Net Margin: Net profit as a percentage of revenue, after all expenses, interest and taxes.

question: How quickly does support first answer a customer?
reference: First Response Time: Average time to the first reply on a support ticket.

question: How many days on average do customers take to pay us?
reference: Days Sales Outstanding: Average days taken to collect payment after a sale.

question: What measures the share of staff who quit on their own?
reference: Voluntary Attrition Rate: Percentage of employees who resigned by their own choice.

question: How often are shelves empty when customers want a product?
reference: Stockout Rate: Percentage of demand lost because items were out of stock.

question: What tells me how well deals in the pipeline turn into wins?
reference: Win Rate: Percentage of sales opportunities that were won.

question: Which metric shows how much cash the company loses each month?
reference: Burn Rate: Net cash spent per month.

question: What measures how many parcels reach customers late?
reference: On-Time Delivery Rate: Percentage of shipments delivered by the promised date.

question: What shows how fast a new recruit starts performing at full speed?
reference: Time to Productivity: Average days for a new hire to reach full productivity.

question: How much does it cost us to attract a brand new buyer?
reference: Customer Acquisition Cost: Average marketing and sales cost to win one new customer.

question: What indicates the share of products that buyers send back?
reference: Return Rate: Percentage of sold units returned by customers.
